PROCEDURE count_calls_with(person:PERSON)
$v0 = FIND CALL WHERE SELF.WHO={person}
$v1 = COUNT $v0
RETURN $v1
END
turns.name: count_calls_with

PROCEDURE count_open_calls_with(person:PERSON)
$v0 = FIND CALL WHERE SELF.WHO={person} STATUS=OPEN
$v1 = COUNT $v0
RETURN $v1
END
